svg.title: The technology behind the city
svg.desc: Project Reborn's stack in five layers. Interface: NUI, React, TypeScript, Vite, Reborn UI. Gameplay: ox_lib, ox_inventory, ox_target, lb-phone, illenium-appearance. Framework: Lua 5.4, ESX Legacy, statebags, lib.callback. Data: MySQL/MariaDB, oxmysql, SQL migrations. Runtime and ops: FXServer, Node.js, Git with submodules, Discord webhooks, PowerShell.
